facts.business: Master Trust Limited is a diversified financial services institution offering research-backed trading and investment solutions across equities, derivatives, currencies, commodities and allied financial services.
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances to related parties were Rs 2,415.60 million as at 31st March 2026 (Rs 576.63 million as at 31st March 2025). Details of loans and advances to firms/companies in which Directors are interested are provided in Note 6 of the consolidated financial statements.
